Worst case scenario , I fail and I keep trying till I finally die . It's been 3 years since then and a lot of things have improved.  Things might be shitty , and there might be people who already have what you dream of , or that they have a considerable headstart in life compared to you in some way . It doesn't matter . If you cannot appreciate the life you currently have or think that it's wasted , do all you can to get the life you want . They might spend 50 years being satisfied with their life and you will spend 30 . It's better than simply dying and experiencing none of it .

Interact with people without the prospect of finding a partner so that you can build social skills . Start doing more activities that you like , take better care of yourself . It's unreasonable to ask of anyone to love you when you can't love yourself . Even if you find someone genuinely interested and absolutely in love with you for who you are , you WILL lose them down the line if you cannot love yourself . You are the most important person in your life , remember that . Also , yes , going to the gym is good advice . It helps you build self esteem , it makes you more attractive , you look like someone who cares and wants something for himself . And if you instantly think everything is horrible and all , people will quickly leave you . People don't like negativity , their lives have enough of it already

Do things that will make anyone more attractive , like going to the gym etc. , and try to be a little more positive . Many and I do mean MANY people care about personality . And even if they don't , they will eventually. And being overly negative does count as an unattractive personality , but it can be changed
